what: With the hero pinned, a small video in the 16:9 slot below the title grows to the whole rounded box as you scroll (left · top · width · height, no curve). Over the same range the overlay on the video darkens 0→.75, and the text on the panel (ink) switches from dark ink to the reverse of the background text color .1 later — pin distance 1.1 screens, scrub 1

options.[data-fx-part=box]: Panel that fills when the video is fully enlarged (child) — position: relative
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Slot where the video first sits (empty)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Growing video box — normally placed inside a slot (on narrow screens it stays in place). While pinned, it sits under the text as absolute relative to the panel with z-index −1, so do not give slot or its ancestors a position
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (Optional) layer inside media — darkens from 0 up to dim
options.distance: Fixed distance (multiple of screen height), default 1.1
options.from: Minimum width to turn on (px), default 992 — below that the video stays in place

note: Original timeline as is: video grow (0~.5), curtain (0~.5) and text color (.1~.6) sit in one timeline, so the video finishes growing at 5/6 of the pinned span and stays still for the last 1/6
